No. 19-357 

IN THE SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES 

CITY OF CHICAGO, 

Applicant, 

v. 

ROBBIN L. FULTON, JASON S. HOWARD, 
GEORGE PEAKE, AND TIMOTHY SHANNON, 

Respondents. 

ON WRIT OF CERTIORARI TO THE 
UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS 
FOR THE SEVENTH CIRCUIT 

APPLICATION FOR EXTENSION OF TIME 
TO FILE REPLY BRIEF ON THE MERITS 

To the Honorable Brett M. Kavanaugh, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the 

United States and Circuit Justice for the Seventh Circuit: 

Pursuant to this Court’s Rule 30.3, the City of Chicago (the “City”) respectfully requests 

a 5-day extension of time to and including April 8, 2020, to file its reply brief on the merits in 

this case.  The Seventh Circuit entered judgment on June 19, 2019.  Pet. App. 1a.  The City filed 

a timely petition for certiorari on September 17, 2019, which this Court granted on December 18, 

2019.  This Court has jurisdiction under 28 U.S.C. §1254(1).  The City filed its brief on the 

merits on February 3, 2020.  The respondents filed their brief on the merits on March 4, 2020.  

Seven amicus briefs in support of respondents were filed on March 10 and March 11, 2020.  The 

City’s reply brief on the merits is currently due on April 3, 2020.  This case is set for oral 

argument on April 20, 2020. 

1

Due to the various disruptions caused by the work-at-home orders in light of the COVID-

19 virus and the complications of collaborating remotely, counsel requires additional time to 

prepare a reply brief on the merits that will most effectively and efficiently present the issues for 

this Court’s consideration.  A 5-day extension to and including April 8, 2020 will ensure that the 

reply brief is actually received by the Clerk more than 10 days before the date of oral argument, 

which is currently set for April 20, 2020, in accordance with this Court’s Rule 25.3.  Counsel for 

the respondents has indicated that the undersigned may inform the Court that the respondents 

consent to the requested extension of time. 

For the foregoing reasons, the City respectfully requests that the time for filing its reply 

brief on the merits in this case be extended to and including April 8, 2020. 

March 31, 2020 

Respectfully submitted. 

/s/ Craig Goldblatt 
CRAIG GOLDBLATT 
      Counsel of Record 
WILMER CUTLER PICKERING 
     HALE AND DORR LLP 
1875 Pennsylvania Ave., NW 
Washington, D.C. 20006 
(202) 663-6000 
craig.goldblatt@wilmerhale.com 

2
